name: [🎄]Build to Ski! ⛷️
desc:
⛷️ Welcome to Build To Ski! ❄️

Travel the world and build your own ski routes across the most iconic mountains on Earth!

💡Build higher → Ski farther → Earn more💡

[How to Play]

🚡 Buy stacks from the shop
🗻 Build your stacks across world-famous mountains
⛷️ Ski down from incredible heights to earn coins
💰 Upgrade your skis and pets
🌎 Unlock new countries and legendary ski spots
